about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of FSA DRIVING! In Nijnait City—inspired by the urban landscape of Tianjin—put your exceptional driving skills to the test. Explore every street, discover the fastest routes, and race against time to deliver for your clients.

A Rich and Engaging Open World
Roam through Nijnait City, modeled after Tianjin, from its vibrant downtown to the vast open wilderness on the outskirts. Collect hidden items and dive into a variety of built-in mini-games and interactive experiences.

Unique Stunt Abilities
Go beyond standard driving with eye-popping maneuvers like blade-style overtakes and aerial glides—moves that would be impossible in the real world.

Business Simulation Elements
Trade specialty goods at shops across the city. Buy low, sell high, and outpace the ever-changing market prices.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 5600X, Core i5-12400
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Ryzen 9 5900X, Core i7-13700
  • Memory: 24 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3070Ti
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Delivery, trading, racing—showcase your superb driving skills in Nijnait City, modeled after Tianjin. Customize your vehicle, drift through corners, perform stunt drives, and glide over the city with a wingsuit. Explore streets, uncover the fastest routes, and save precious time for your clients.
supported_languages:
English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
